instruction: Ensure that future xp requests use 100 game variations or smaller with counterfactuals.
comparison: Same baseline seed, resolved roster, engine/config and probe slot; replace only the subject policy and rerun responsive policies. Record baseline/candidate episode IDs and paired score deltas.
selection: Freeze candidate, baseline cohort selection, contexts and analysis before viewing counterfactual outcomes. Use paired uncertainty estimates; unmatched random-seed A/B is not a counterfactual.
budget: Count every newly created baseline and counterfactual episode in the existing shared ledger; preserve daily100000, cycle400 and concurrency3. Per-request100 is not the daily limit.
api: Use /v2/counterfactual-evals with explicit n between1and100, subject to live schema and audited seed/roster/config fidelity; a new journaled adapter is needed before first use. Do not treat fixed opposing replay actions as responsive counterfactuals.
scope: Future studies; preserve old frozen requests, results and their original statistical design.
